title: Zephyr IDE Configuration
description: Workspace configuration file for the IDE for Zephyr VS Code extension (zephyr-ide.json). Stores project configurations, runner profiles, and workspace requirements.

projects.description: Project configurations keyed by project name.

activeProject.description: Name of the currently active project.

runnerProfiles.description: Workspace-level runner profiles for flash/debug/attach operations. Profiles defined here override user-level profiles with the same name.

toolchains.description: Zephyr SDK toolchain names required by this workspace (e.g. 'arm-zephyr-eabi', 'riscv64-zephyr-elf'). Missing toolchains are installed automatically during workspace setup.

blobs.description: West module names whose binary blobs should be fetched via 'west blobs fetch <module>'.

pipPackages.description: Python packages to be installed in the workspace's virtual environment.

pipRequirements.description: Relative paths (from workspace root) to requirements.txt files whose packages should be installed in the workspace's virtual environment alongside any pipPackages.

items.description: Relative path to a requirements.txt file (e.g. 'external/nrf/scripts/requirements.txt')

commands.description: Platform-specific terminal commands that can be run after workspace setup. Users are prompted to review and approve commands before execution.

linux.description: Commands offered when running on Linux.

windows.description: Commands offered when running on Windows.

mac.description: Commands offered when running on macOS.

sdkVersion.description: Zephyr SDK version to install when bootstrapping (e.g. '0.17.0'). If omitted, the version from the Zephyr tree's SDK_VERSION file is used; if that is unavailable, the latest released SDK is installed.

sampleProjects.description: Optional sample project configurations. Not loaded automatically on startup — use 'Zephyr IDE: Add Sample Projects From File' to load them interactively.

oneOf.description: Legacy format: relative path to the project directory from the workspace root.

ProjectConfig.description: Configuration for a Zephyr IDE project.

rel_path.description: Path to the project directory, relative to the workspace root.

buildConfigs.description: Build configurations for this project, keyed by build name.

confFiles.description: Project-level Kconfig (.conf) and devicetree overlay (.overlay) files applied to all builds.

twisterConfigs.description: Twister (test runner) configurations for this project, keyed by configuration name.

customVars.description: User-defined key-value variables for this project. Accessible in runner profile args as '${projectvar:key}' and via the 'zephyr-ide.get-active-project-variable' command.

BuildConfig.description: A single build configuration within a project.

name.description: Display name for this build configuration.

rel_path.description: Custom build output directory, relative to the workspace root. If omitted, defaults to '<project_rel_path>/<build_name>'.

relBoardDir.description: Relative path (from workspace root) to a custom board directory. The parent of this path is passed as BOARD_ROOT to CMake. Leave empty to use Zephyr's built-in boards.

relBoardSubDir.description: Board subdirectory within the board root (e.g. 'vendor/my_board'). Used to construct the full board path.

compilerOptimization.description: Compiler optimization level preset. When omitted, no optimization flag is passed (configured via KConfig).

westBuildCMakeArgs.description: Additional CMake definitions passed to 'west build' via '--' (e.g. ['-DCONFIG_FOO=y']).

activeProfile.description: Name of the runner profile to use for flash/debug/attach. Must match a profile name in 'runnerProfiles' (workspace or user). When omitted, 'Auto' mode is used (runners.yaml picks the runner).

bindOverrides.description: Per-slot extra-argument overrides appended after the active runner profile's resolved args. Only applies to slots whose profile bind kind is 'west-flash' or 'west-debug'.

customVars.description: User-defined key-value variables for this build. Accessible in runner profile args as '${buildvar:key}' and via the 'zephyr-ide.get-active-build-variable' command.

confFiles.description: Build-level Kconfig (.conf) and devicetree overlay (.overlay) files, merged with the project-level confFiles.

revision.description: Board revision string appended to the board target (e.g. '1.0.0').

ConfigFiles.description: Kconfig (.conf) and devicetree overlay (.overlay) configuration files.

config.description: Kconfig configuration files (.conf). Entries without 'extra: true' are passed as CONF_FILE; entries with 'extra: true' are passed as EXTRA_CONF_FILE.

overlay.description: Devicetree overlay files (.overlay). Entries without 'extra: true' are passed as DTC_OVERLAY_FILE; entries with 'extra: true' are passed as EXTRA_DTC_OVERLAY_FILE.

path.description: Path to the configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

extra.description: When true, the file is passed as EXTRA_CONF_FILE or EXTRA_DTC_OVERLAY_FILE. When false or omitted, it is passed as CONF_FILE or DTC_OVERLAY_FILE.

name.description: Display name for this Twister configuration.

platform.description: Target platform string passed to Twister (e.g. 'native_sim', 'qemu_x86').

tests.description: Test case identifiers to run (from testcase.yaml or sample.yaml).

args.description: Additional arguments passed to the Twister command.

serialBaud.description: Serial baud rate for hardware testing (e.g. '115200').

boardConfig.description: Board configuration for hardware Twister runs.

BoardConfig.description: Board selection for a build or Twister configuration.

relBoardDir.description: Relative path to a custom board directory. Leave empty to use Zephyr's built-in boards.

relBoardSubDir.description: Board subdirectory within the board root.

RunnerProfile.description: A named set of flash/debug/attach bindings for use across build configurations.

flash.description: How to perform 'Flash' and 'Build and Flash' actions.

debug.description: How to perform 'Debug' actions (and 'Build and Debug' when 'buildDebug' is not set).

buildDebug.description: How to perform 'Build and Debug' when 'zephyr-ide.separateBuildDebugProfile' is enabled. Falls back to 'debug' when omitted or when the setting is disabled.

FlashBind.description: Selects how a Flash / Build-and-Flash action is executed.

oneOf.description: Use runners.yaml defaults — west picks the runner automatically.
Invoke 'west flash -r <runner>' with optional extra arguments.

kind.description: Invoke 'west flash' with a specific runner.

extraArgs.description: Extra argument tokens appended after the runner name.

DebugBind.description: Selects how a Debug / Attach / Build-and-Debug action is run.

oneOf.description: Use runners.yaml defaults, auto-translated to a cortex-debug configuration.
Reference a launch.json configuration by name.

name.description: Name of the launch.json configuration to use.

oneOf.description: Name a Zephyr runner and configure structured cortex-debug options. The zephyr-ide debug provider auto-fills ELF/GDB/target from runners.yaml.

kind.description: Use cortex-debug with a specific Zephyr runner.

enableRtt.description: When true, '--enable-rtt' is injected so the RTT terminal opens automatically. Only valid for runners that support RTT (openocd, jlink, bmp).

probe.description: Probe/interface selection. For openocd: path to an OpenOCD interface config (e.g. 'interface/stlink.cfg'). For pyocd: probe identifier (e.g. 'stlink', 'cmsis_dap'). Ignored for other runners.

oneOf.description: Invoke 'west debugserver' and connect cortex-debug as an external GDB server.

kind.description: Use 'west debugserver' with a specific runner.

runner.description: Zephyr runner name forwarded to 'west debugserver' (e.g. 'nrfjprog', 'linkserver', 'esp32').

extraArgs.description: Extra argument tokens forwarded to 'west debugserver' after the runner name.

BindOverride.description: Per-build extra-argument override appended after a runner profile's slot extraArgs. Only effective for 'west-flash' and 'west-debug' slot kinds.

extraArgs.description: Extra arg tokens appended after the profile's extraArgs.
